description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid class, which manages thread-safe notifications of network changes on Android, including connection type, cost, bandwidth, and default network status. It includes observer interface and JNI interaction methods.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid
classes.description: Manages thread-safe notifications of network state changes on Android, including observer registration, JNI callbacks, and network info retrieval.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that observe network change events such as connection type, cost, bandwidth, and default network activity.

methods.name: NotifyConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update connection type and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyConnectionCostChanged
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update connection cost and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyMaxBandwidthChanged
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update max bandwidth and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkConnect
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate a network connection event.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate a network will disconnect soon.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkDisconnect
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate a network disconnect.

methods.name: NotifyPurgeActiveNetworkList
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update active network list.

methods.name: NotifyOfDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate default network is active.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for network change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from network change notifications.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves current max bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkConnectionType
methods.description: Returns connection type for a given network handle.

methods.name: GetCurrentlyConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Fills list with currently connected networks.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Checks if default network is active.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns current connection subtype (main thread only).
